description: Read messages from a receive-only agent inbox — Returns the emails and webhook deliveries that arrived in an inbox you created with inbox-create, oldest first, with sender, subject, selected headers, a plain-text body (up to 64 KB per message in the response) and a sha256 of the stored body. Filter by since (inclusive), kind, limit up to 100; mark_consumed hides the returned messages from later polls unless include_consumed is true. It does not

include_consumed.description: Also return consumed messages. Default false.

mark_consumed.description: Mark the returned messages consumed. Default false.

since.description: Only messages received at or after this time: epoch milliseconds or ISO 8601 (UTC when no offset). Inclusive, so dedupe by id or use mark_consumed.

tenantId.description: Required for API-key callers (namespace as key:<tenantId>; keep it unguessable). Ignored when a wallet paid.

name: inbox-poll
